Semrush

Turn search research into a prioritized growth roadmap.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Semrush provides search research, competitive analysis, and site audit capabilities. MoreSpace can organize keyword themes, identify technical and content opportunities, and build a practical SEO roadmap that connects market demand with useful pages and clearly documented performance measures.

Useful outputs

  • Prioritized keyword themes and content opportunity briefs
  • Technical issue backlog with ownership and acceptance criteria
  • SEO reporting views that distinguish estimates from observed outcomes

Where we can apply it

  • Service priorities → keyword research → content brief → reviewed page launch.
  • Site audit → issue prioritization → developer backlog → verified resolution.
  • Research exports → Search Console outcomes → SEO scorecard → next-quarter roadmap.
01

Use case 1

Research search themes and competitors for an agreed target market.

02

Use case 2

Prioritize technical website issues and content opportunities by business relevance.

03

Use case 3

Combine approved exports or API reports with an SEO performance dashboard.

Inputs we need

  • Website domains, target markets, and relevant competitor set
  • Priority services, search themes, and existing content inventory
  • Authorized project access and agreed reporting definitions

Delivery sequence

  • Agree the market, competitors, and business questions before collecting reports.
  • Review site findings and keyword opportunities against commercial priorities.
  • Connect the approved research with a content plan and source-backed measurement.

Expert review points

  • Validate technical findings and page relevance before assigning implementation work.
  • Label estimates and verify API allowances before automating recurring reports.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Google Search Console
  • Content workflows
  • Reporting tools
  • HTTP APIs

Signals we can make visible

  • Organic clicks
  • Keyword visibility
  • Audit issues resolved
  • Organic lead conversion rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
